memories.content: Lives near the proposed skate-park relocation site. Has received both supportive and opposing letters from neighbors. Has not yet decided how to vote.

The Riverton parks committee will hold a session on Thursday, 2026-09-17, where a vote on the skate-park relocation will occur. The relocation has been through two noisy public-comment periods. The local paper ran letters both for and against last week. The committee has five members.
